item.title: Buttigieg returns to South Carolina as he considers another presidential bid
item.description: Buttigieg's last political speech in South Carolina marked a distant primary finish, and now he returns as he weighs another run.

item.title: Defending the Supreme Court's Legitimacy
item.description: The Court's legitimacy is based on its decision-making process, not the outcomes.

item.title: Is Trump enough? Darline Graham embraces president's endorsement in South Carolina's Senate runoff
item.description: Sen. Darline Graham's lead in unpublished polls narrowed before Tuesday's Republican primary runoff, but that was before the president's endorsement.

item.title: What Totalitarianism Could Not Destroy
item.description: Black Ribbon Day shows that hope can survive in a system built on fear and historical amnesia.
